stage_b_reviewed_content.statement:
Let $\mathcal{A}$ be an abelian category.
Let
$$
\text{Cov} = \{\{f : V \to U\} \mid f\text{ is surjective}\}.
$$
Then $(\mathcal{A}, \text{Cov})$ is a site.
